coverage_limitations: All counts are static expected NOT_RUN; no Gradle or MySQL has executed for this candidate.
Controller fixtures use standalone MockMvc with mocked service and manually created JWT principal; not a real deployed JWT filter chain or full application start.

Service fixtures instantiate ChatBountyRequestIndexService directly with a Mockito TaskRoots interface. They check reflective invocation on that test double, not injection of @Qualifier("agentTaskMetaDaoImpl") into the real Spring context/DAO proxy.
Read-only REPEATABLE_READ is checked as an annotation; no real Spring transaction proxy/MVCC service transaction is exercised by these new tests.

MySQL nested cases exercise the actual store SQL against isolated tables: scope filters, 102-row pagination, low-ordinal late commit rescan, count/state_version/updated_at sums. They do not prove end-to-end new-service projection or zero writes across every production business table.
Feature-default-off is annotation metadata asserted, not application-context bean absence.
No claim of complete Spring startup, 34-product/29-fixture acceptance, Provider execution, build/deploy, or unchanged Voice/Agent test rerun.
New worktree normal Gradle history can invalidate source-path fingerprints; existing normal output is not proof of source binding, and only actual Gradle task outcome/reports can justify reuse.
The fixed output root is reused only under orchestrator global Gradle lock; no copied bytecode, manual task skips, or source overlays.

material_strategy_change.hypothesis_only: Separating normal production compile and test task graphs can reduce per-daemon retained state. Not proven to prevent OOM; cache warmth is not a PASS result. Gradle alone decides UP-TO-DATE from exact current inputs.
material_strategy_change.material_change: Two separate normal-graph invocations/daemons: production compileJava first, original eight-class chatDeliberation run second, instead of one combined test invocation from cold task history.
